# Frankencoin Collateral Platform

> Everything about the assets that back Frankencoin (ZCHF), the decentralized Swiss-franc stablecoin: independent collateral risk assessments, live on-chain positions and prices, community discussion threads, and the version history of every assessment.

## Pages

- Overview and dashboard of all collaterals: https://collateral.frankencoin.com/
- Detail page per collateral: https://collateral.frankencoin.com/collateral/<ticker> (e.g. /collateral/wsteth, /collateral/wbtc)
- Historical version of an assessment: /collateral/<ticker>?v=<commit-sha>
- Diff between two versions: /collateral/<ticker>/compare?from=<sha>&to=<sha>
- Risk assessment methodology: https://collateral.frankencoin.com/framework

## Machine-readable

- All collaterals (assessment scores + live protocol figures, one row each): https://collateral.frankencoin.com/api/collaterals.json
- One collateral in full (frontmatter, markdown, live positions): https://collateral.frankencoin.com/api/collateral/<ticker>.json
- Service health: https://collateral.frankencoin.com/health

## Upstream sources

- Assessments (markdown, JSON frontmatter): https://github.com/Frankencoin-ZCHF/frankencoin-collateral-assessments
- Protocol API: https://api.frankencoin.com
- Community proposals: https://github.com/Frankencoin-ZCHF/Frankencoin/discussions/categories/acceptable-collaterals
- Frankencoin MCP server for AI agents: https://mcp.frankencoin.com
- Main site: https://frankencoin.com
